title: Next stop digital posters

location.series: Pentagram / Natural History Museum case study
location.extent: Published video poster and complete associated clip

slide_intent: Animate a repeated campaign without losing its hierarchy, because viewers should recognize the offer even during movement.
strategic_value: The repeated Next stop phrase can connect Mars, dinosaurs and a dodo to the idea of a Museum journey.
demonstration: Three framed digital posters retain white Next stop headlines and colored Mars, Dinos and Dodo labels while symbols and specimen imagery move within them.
practical_value: Compare animation inside a fixed headline-and-label structure across three subjects.

content_islands.name: Poster family
content_islands.spec: Align three dark portrait displays in the same wall setting.

content_islands.name: Fixed messages
content_islands.spec: Keep Next stop large in white and each subject label colored beneath.

content_islands.name: Moving elements
content_islands.spec: Animate the upper radial marks and specimen imagery within each display.

reference_purposes.Application: Three framed digital posters retain white Next stop headlines and colored Mars, Dinos and Dodo labels while symbols and specimen imagery move within them.
